description:
FILED s464 (Fable, 2026-09-02) from an sb-sprof profile of an arrhash-shaped program (`for my $i (1..600000) { my $k = "k" . ($i % 500); $h{$k}++; push @a, $i }`) on main 3d666ea: %make-p-box 15.4 % self, box-set 8.1 %, gethash/equal 6.4 %, %p-.-slow 14.5 % total, %p-array-store-scalar 4.7 %, p-push-impl 12 % total, %p-fixnum-string 3.8 %.  The row already beats perl (0.67x) -- this is the residue.  THE EMISSION: `(let (($k (make-p-box nil))) (p-my-= $k (p-. "k" (p-% $i 500))) (p-post++ (p-gethash-box %h $k)) (p-push @a $i))` -- one box allocated per iteration for $k, then a box-set into it.  $k did not get the raw-slot verdict; MEASURE WHY first (its uses are a string write and a hash-key read -- #922 recorded that a raw slot used as a hash key was 9.9 % SLOWER than a box because the box caches its string form, but a raw STRING slot has no stringify at all: the key IS the string, so that finding may not apply to a string-valued slot).  TWO CANDIDATE FIXES, measure both: (a) raw-string slot for a `my` whose every use is string-shaped (write from `.`/literal, read as a hash key / print / `.`) -- the existing verdict family; (b) box REUSE: perl allocates a loop-body `my` once in the pad and only clears it per iteration (a fresh SV only when the old one is still referenced) -- PCL could hoist `(make-p-box nil)` out of the loop and `box-set` per iteration when VarAnnotator proves the box does not escape the iteration (no \$k, no closure capture, no push of the box itself, no alias) -- that is a Kind-A emission with a facts license.  ALSO in the same profile: `"k" . NUM` takes %p-.-slow (a fixnum operand misses p-.'s inline string fast path and pays the overload dispatch) -- a (string, fixnum) arm that stringifies the fixnum via %p-fixnum-string without the overload check is a runtime-only fix; and `$h{$k}++` goes through p-gethash-box (a box per element for the ++ place) -- the catalogue's A1 single-probe raw update.  BAR: bench all rows main vs branch with a control pair (arrhash, slices, feread, listcopy are the reachable rows); the full sweep; PCL_OPT=none identical; probes for the escape cases of (b) (closure capturing $k in the loop, `push @r, \$k`, `$h{x} = \$k`, string eval reading $k) vs perl.

== MEASURED, NOT IMPLEMENTED (s465bb, Opus round 23, 2026-09-03) ==
The task's FIRST instruction was "MEASURE WHY $k did not get the raw-slot
verdict".  Measured, and the answer supersedes BOTH candidate fixes: neither a
raw-string slot (a) nor box reuse (b) is needed.  $k already qualifies for the
existing raw slot; ONE FALSE-POSITIVE BOXING EVENT takes it away.

THE MEASUREMENT (scratch/k995.pl and scratch/k995b.pl in the s465bb worktree):

  PCL_B_DEBUG=1 ./pl2cl scratch/k995.pl
    my (%h,@a); for my $i (1..600000) { my $k = "k".($i%500); $h{$k}++; push @a,$i }
    B-DEBUG $k unboxable=0 coerce=- strbuf=0 reasons=[write-incdec] uses={strkey=1}
    emission: (let (($k (make-p-box nil))) (p-my-= $k (p-. "k" (p-% $i 500))) ...)

  the SAME program with `$h{$k} = 1` instead of `$h{$k}++`
    B-DEBUG $k unboxable=1 coerce=- strbuf=0 reasons=[] uses={strkey=1}
    emission: (let (($k (p-. "k" (p-% $i 5)))) (setf (p-gethash %h $k) 1) ...)
    -- a RAW slot: no make-p-box, no box-set, per iteration.

So the profile's 15.4 % %make-p-box + 8.1 % box-set on this row is ONE event:
the `++` is attributed as a WRITE to the hash KEY.

THE MECHANISM, located.  `Pl/VarAnnotator.pm` ~line 976, the tree walker's
prefix_op/postfix_op arm.  When the operand of `++`/`--` is a BARE symbol the
arm records `incdec_root` and a 'num' use and returns (the A-num regime).  When
it is anything else -- `$h{$k}++`, `$a[$i]++` -- it falls through to

    _tw_mark($ctx, $xo, $kids->[$ex_i], 'write-incdec');

and `_tw_mark` marks EVERY name in the operand SUBTREE.  For `$h{$k}++` that
subtree is the hash access, whose children are the container `%h` AND the key
expression `$k`.  But `++` writes the ELEMENT; the key (and, for `$a[$i]++`,
the index) is READ.  The over-marking is not needed for the one case the
comment names -- `++($x = 5)`, where $x really is written -- because the
generic `_tw_walk($ctx, $xo, $kids->[$ex_i], 0)` on the very next line already
walks that subtree and records the embedded assignment.

THE FIX, ONE MECHANISM: mark the write on the LVALUE PATH of the operand (the
container/root symbol chain) and not on subscript / key subtrees, which stay
ordinary READS.  `$i` in `$a[$i]++` is the same false positive and is fixed by
the same line.

WHY IT WAS NOT SHIPPED IN s465bb: it is a VarAnnotator boxing-verdict change,
i.e. exactly the class where the CLAUDE.md cadence table says "the sweep IS the
gate", and a verdict that stops firing WIDENS what the raw emission covers, so
it also needs the gate-SET scan over both populations (s372 rule) plus the
bench with a control pair.  That is a session's bar set; #994's own bars were
in flight.  Nothing about the finding is provisional -- the two B-DEBUG lines
and the two emissions above are the whole argument.

ACCEPTANCE, when it is taken:
- the two probe programs above: $k unboxable=1 in BOTH, emission raw in both;
- `$a[$i]++` in a loop: $i must also lose its write-incdec reason;
- the cases the marking is there FOR must keep it: `++($x = 5)` (embedded
  assignment), `++$$r`, `++$h{$k}{$j}` (every container on the path);
- bench arrhash / slices / feread / listcopy main vs branch WITH a control pair;
- the full sweep + gate-SET scan over both populations; PCL_OPT=none identical.

The task's other two observations were NOT measured here and stand as filed:
`"k" . NUM` taking %p-.-slow (a runtime-only (string, fixnum) arm), and
`$h{$k}++` going through p-gethash-box (the catalogue's A1 single-probe raw
update).

=== SIZED (s473p, 2026-09-07) — the two residues, measured ===
This task's own box-per-iteration is GONE (s468bd shipped the write-incdec
fix): re-verified on the s473p tree with `PCL_B_DEBUG=1` on the task's own
reproducer — `$k unboxable=1 reasons=[] uses={strkey=1}`, emission
`(p-let (($k :scalar (p-. "k" (p-% $i 500)))) …)`, no `make-p-box`, no
`box-set`.  So round 30 measured the two observations this task left open,
and the numbers decide both.

RE-PROFILED (sb-sprof, :cpu, 1 ms, the arrhash-k shape at N=1.2 M on the
current tree — scratch/s473p/prof.lisp): `%p-.-slow` 23.7 % self / 33.8 %
total, `sb-impl::gethash/equal` 16.5 % self, `box-set` 5.8 %,
`p-gethash-box` 4.3 % self / 33.8 % total, `extend-vector` 4.3 %,
`%p-array-store-scalar` 3.6 %.

(a) THE `"k" . NUM` ARM IS WORTH NOTHING — the finding, and it kills the
suggestion.  A `(string, fixnum)` arm in `p-.` that stringifies through
`%p-fixnum-string` and skips the overload dispatch measures **27.0 ns against
today's 27.4 ns** (best-of-5 over 5 M calls, 3-char key,
scratch/s473p/probe3.lisp) — 1.5 %, i.e. nothing.  A "no box on either side"
arm is WORSE (37.0 ns).  `%p-.-slow`'s 23.7 % self is `concatenate 'string`
and its allocation, NOT `%with-binary-overload`: the overload test for two raw
operands is one `p-box-p` per side and settles immediately
(`%p-no-overload-possible-p`'s first clause).  A `simple-string`
make-string+replace spelling was tried too and is SLOWER than `concatenate`
(96 ms vs 80 ms over 2 M).  Do not retry any of these three.

(b) THE SINGLE-PROBE RAW UPDATE FOR `$h{$k}++` IS REAL, AND SIZED: today's
`(p-post++ (p-gethash-box %h $k))` costs **43.5 ns**; a raw update — one
gethash read, `p-+`, one gethash write — costs **25.5 ns**, i.e. **-41 %**
(best-of-5 over 2 M updates across 500 keys, scratch/s473p/probe4.lisp).  On
arrhash-k that is ~18 ns per iteration = **~17.6 % of the row**, which is
BELOW round 30's own 20 %-of-the-row bar, so it was not taken.  What it needs
when it is: a new emission (`(%p-hash-post++ %h $k)`, Kind-A) plus a runtime
op, because the box path must remain reachable — `%p-hash-elem-cell` PROMOTES
a raw slot to a box on the first lvalue touch and today's shape therefore
never sees a raw slot twice, so a raw update must NOT promote, and the
presence of a box in the slot is then exactly the runtime signal that
something aliases the element (`\$h{$k}`, a tie, magic) and the box path must
be taken.  That is the whole licence, and it is a runtime test, not a
compile-time fact.


STATUS after s473p (2026-09-07): the task stays OPEN and it now carries
exactly one lever.  (i) The box-per-iteration this task was FILED for is DONE
(s468bd, re-verified on the s473p tree).  (ii) Residue (a), the `"k" . NUM`
arm, is CLOSED BY MEASUREMENT at 1.5 % -- do not retry it, in any of the three
spellings measured above.  (iii) Residue (b), the single-probe raw update for
`$h{$k}++`, is the open lever: -41 % of the op, ~17.6 % of the arrhash-k row,
below round 30's 20 %-of-the-row bar, with its licence written down (a box in
the slot IS the runtime signal that something aliases the element).  A later
round takes it as `%p-hash-post++` (Kind-A) plus the runtime op.
